curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify small and capital lettersfrom a text

mission.title: identify small and capital lettersfrom a text

interactions.feedback: Yes! M is a capital letter.

interactions.prompt: Which small letter matches capital P?
interactions.feedback: Correct! P and p are the same letter.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the small letter with the same shape family.

interactions.prompt: Match each capital letter to its small letter.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a capital letter, then tap its small-letter match.
interactions.feedback: Great matching! A goes with a, and B goes with b.
interactions.retryHint: Say each letter name before matching.

interactions.prompt: Read: Kendi has a Kite. Which capital letter is in the text?
interactions.feedback: Well spotted! K is the capital letter.
interactions.retryHint: Find the taller form of k.

interactions.prompt: Sort the letters into capital and small groups.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a letter, then tap its group.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You sorted every capital and small letter.
interactions.retryHint: Capital letters are the larger forms.

interactions.prompt: Which pair shows one capital and its matching small letter?
interactions.feedback: Super reading! G and g are matching forms.
interactions.retryHint: The two letters should have the same name.
